title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin closed the US session at seventy-three thousand five hundred twenty-two dollars, up just a tenth of a percent, showing quiet resilience inside extreme fear at a twenty-three reading.  

Daily range stayed tight with no decisive breakout, leaving price pinned near current levels. Network strength remains intact with hashrate at nine hundred fifty-nine EH/s and the mempool clearing at forty-six thousand transactions with fees as low as two sat per vbyte.
